item.title: SHEMM Coach
item.description: Today, let's talk Eating. No notes logged, so let's set a baseline. Your day has structure around it — meals bookend a full schedule, with meditation, walks, and check-ins in between. Don't let a packed day push eating to the margins or turn it into another box to tick. Notice hunger versus habit at the table. Action: before dinner tonight, pause for one breath and ask if you're actually hungry.
